gold: Radioiodine-refractory vesicular thyroid carcinoma (VTC) with sinonasal metastasis

selector.rationale: The presence of a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities, along with biopsy results confirming VTC metastasis, strongly supports Vascularized Thyroid Cancer Metastasis as the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Follicular Thyroid Carcinoma
rejected.why: Low iodine uptake in the sinonasal tumor contradicts typical Follicular Thyroid Carcinoma characteristics

rejected.label: Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma
rejected.why: Elevated serum thyroglobulin levels contradict Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma, which typically has low or no thyroglobulin production

rejected.label: Anaplastic Thyroid Carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of relevant medical history and absence of typical aggressive features of Anaplastic Thyroid Carcinoma make it less likely
